messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Use the provided camera reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described side full-body camera setup and movement. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then lifts one foot to remove a shoe, which lands on the ground, and finally stands with arms lowered.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-full shot from the side.","clothing":"A light blue long-sleeved sweater, dark blue cropped pants, yellow socks, and brown slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright green.","hairstyle":"Short, neatly cropped hair.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned 3D-rendered character with a short, youthful face, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or plaza with a large gray metal structure, tiled flooring, and city buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the same character from a side profile in a full-body framing, with the large gray structure behind them and the character placed near the center, closely matching the reference. The character's green hair, blue sweater, dark cropped pants, socks, and brown shoes remain consistent, and the action progresses similarly from standing to removing a shoe.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a full-body side camera setup matching the reference image's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, clothing, action, scene, and timing.
unexpected_changes: The background environment differs from the source: the original street scene with signs and buildings is replaced by a rooftop/plaza area with a large gray metal structure, though this matches the provided camera reference.
